### Key Implementation Highlights
- **Deterministic Replay & Scrubbing (Seed `42`):**
  - Uses Mulberry32 ([`createPRNG`](file:///private/tmp/pcd-sbx-gemini-4-carbon-r9y1yspq/work/index.html#L192-L200)) seeded strictly with `42` (zero calls to `Math.random()` or `Date.now()`).
  - Precomputes `1 / 240` s spring-chain tether recoil steps ([`precomputeTetherTimeline`](file:///private/tmp/pcd-sbx-gemini-4-carbon-r9y1yspq/work/index.html#L337-L443)) and evaluates exact closed-form kinematics, drag, and gravity integrals ([`renderAt`](file:///private/tmp/pcd-sbx-gemini-4-carbon-r9y1yspq/work/index.html#L2283-L2333)) so forward playback, reverse scrubbing, and `Re-fire` produce identical frames at any `simTime` in `[0.000, 8.000]`.
- **Scene, Studio Optics & Three.js `r128` Configuration:**
  - Mounts onto `#stage` with `alpha: true`, `renderer.outputEncoding = THREE.sRGBEncoding`, narrow `35°` lateral perspective framing, detached procedural studio environment reflections ([`createStudioEnvironment`](file:///private/tmp/pcd-sbx-gemini-4-carbon-r9y1yspq/work/index.html#L497-L537)), and three-point lighting with cool-cyan and magenta dual rim lights.
  - Hydrostatic teardrop balloon geometry ([`evaluateTeardropProfile`](file:///private/tmp/pcd-sbx-gemini-4-carbon-r9y1yspq/work/index.html#L278-L287), [`buildBalloonBaseGeometry`](file:///private/tmp/pcd-sbx-gemini-4-carbon-r9y1yspq/work/index.html#L625-L703)) paired with dual-pass semi-translucent `#e61c24` crimson latex shaders ([`createLatexMaterial`](file:///private/tmp/pcd-sbx-gemini-4-carbon-r9y1yspq/work/index.html#L705-L891)) featuring specular gloss, subsurface transmission, and Fresnel rim highlights.
- **Six-Phase Ballistic & Fluid Physics (`0.000s – 8.000s`):**
  - **Approach (`0.000s – 1.000s`):** Spinning copper/brass ogive projectile with aerodynamic Mach bow-wave ([`buildBulletAssembly`](file:///private/tmp/pcd-sbx-gemini-4-carbon-r9y1yspq/work/index.html#L1868-L1982), [`getBulletState`](file:///private/tmp/pcd-sbx-gemini-4-carbon-r9y1yspq/work/index.html#L292-L327)).
  - **Elastic Contact & Burst (`1.000s – 1.600s`):** Right-wall elastic indentation followed by star-petal tearing, rolled-lip recoil, and rapid contraction toward the whipping tether knot.
  - **Inertial Stasis (`1.600s – 2.400s`):** Exposed refractive water mass ([`createWaterBodyMaterial`](file:///private/tmp/pcd-sbx-gemini-4-carbon-r9y1yspq/work/index.html#L897-L1047)) holding the suspended teardrop silhouette with capillary ripples and internal shock scatter.
  - **Cavitation Tunnel & Wake (`2.400s – 3.800s`):** Expanding Kelvin-Helmholtz ribbed vapor cavity ([`createCavitationMaterial`](file:///private/tmp/pcd-sbx-gemini-4-carbon-r9y1yspq/work/index.html#L1092-L1173)) and rightward backward splash jet ([`createCrownConeMaterial`](file:///private/tmp/pcd-sbx-gemini-4-carbon-r9y1yspq/work/index.html#L1178-L1255)).
  - **Exit Puncture & Forward Cone (`3.800s – 5.000s`):** Left-wall bulge breach projecting a high-velocity forward conical mist and micro-droplet plume ([`buildMistSpraySystem`](file:///private/tmp/pcd-sbx-gemini-4-carbon-r9y1yspq/work/index.html#L1587-L1780) using detached sprite atlas [`createFluidSpriteAtlas`](file:///private/tmp/pcd-sbx-gemini-4-carbon-r9y1yspq/work/index.html#L448-L495)).
  - **Fluid Disintegration & Splashdown (`5.000s – 8.000s`):** Cellular Rayleigh-Taylor sheet perforation and 3,600 GPU-instanced 3D droplets/Plateau-Rayleigh primary-satellite chains ([`buildDropletsSystem`](file:///private/tmp/pcd-sbx-gemini-4-carbon-r9y1yspq/work/index.html#L1261-L1582)) cascading under gravity into concentric splashdown ripples ([`buildSplashdownRipples`](file:///private/tmp/pcd-sbx-gemini-4-carbon-r9y1yspq/work/index.html#L1785-L1863)).
- **Playback State Machine & Canonical Dock:**
  - Implements the exact 5-state machine (`COUNTDOWN`, `PLAYING`, `PAUSED`, `REFIRE_HOLD`, `ENDED`) inside [`initApplication`](file:///private/tmp/pcd-sbx-gemini-4-carbon-r9y1yspq/work/index.html#L2045-L2515) over the verbatim `#countdown` and `#dock` markup and CSS.
